message.content: {"call_911_if": [{"id": "b1", "text": "Go to the emergency room or call 911 if you gain more than 2 pounds in one day or 5 pounds in one week.", "sources": ["p1:L26", "p1:L27"]}, {"id": "b2", "text": "Go to the emergency room or call 911 if you have trouble breathing while resting or lying flat.", "sources": ["p1:L26", "p1:L28", "term:SOB"]}, {"id": "b3", "text": "Go to the emergency room or call 911 if you have chest pain that does not go away after taking 3 nitroglycerin doses.", "sources": ["p1:L26", "p1:L29"]}, {"id": "b4", "text": "Go to the emergency room or call 911 if you faint or have a very slow heartbeat.", "sources": ["p1:L26", "p1:L30"]}]}
